name: emet
description: Sends each Claude Code turn to Emet, which checks the claims in the answer against the tool results behind them.

api_key.title: Emet key
api_key.description: From Emet: Applications, then Manage keys. Kept in Claude Code's secure credential store, not in settings.json.

tenant_ref.title: Team ID
tenant_ref.description: The External ID of your team, from Teams in Emet.

capture_mode.title: Capture mode
capture_mode.description: sanitized sends content with secrets redacted, full sends content as is, metadata sends no content (Emet cannot check claims).
